name: 서리 칼날
prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Asset: single fantasy inventory pixel-art sprite. First input image is edit target (or original design to restore). Preserve current pixel-art style, coarse square clusters, dark stepped outlines, palette and proportions except explicitly requested changes. Keep original sword design, all existing frost and ice encrustation around blade base and guard, silver blade, blue grip, cyan jewel. Add a NARROW SKY-BLUE INLAID STRIPE down blade CENTER starting immediately ABOVE guard and ending at about HALFWAY up blade. Stripe is a crisp straight saturated sky-blue band with darker cyan side edge, visibly distinct from the irregular pale white frost already present. Do not remove ice texture. Keep entire silhouette and1:3 canvas positions.
Return exactly ONE item. No text labels, watermark, grid or backdrop. Preserve real alpha transparency; no black background. No blurring or antialias smoothing. Full object with safe transparent margins. Inventory footprint (# occupied, . empty), top-to-bottom: #/#/#
